hypothesis: Measure learning/generalization across four tasks and sample sizes; success on one quantum-friendly task is not broad capability.
design: 3 independent data seeds, nested16/64/128 training points;128 disjoint validation and512 test points. Validation selects checkpoints/restarts; test never used for fitting.
optimizer: L-BFGS-B120 iterations,2 restarts for QNN/MLP,one convex fit for linear/Fourier; report all failures.
fairness: Same data. Unequal parameter/function classes and simulator costs reported. Fourier baseline intentionally strong generic nonlinear control. Not a quantum advantage test or full language task.
